title: 阪神JFの後に・Oh！パールファミリー

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: See? You can run well even if you're not part of some famous family. And Dober's a part of my family now! Dual affiliation is totally okay with me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm running in the Oka Sho next! Time to recruit more members for the Pearl family!
